title: Fixed datum pullback completeness
statement: For a separated, locally finite-type, quasi-compact morphism f:X -> Y, a finite-field datum D with l != p, and an object K represented over the completed coefficient sheaf, if K is derived complete for D then its ordinary ringed pullback is derived complete for D.

proof_origin.place: H8 withdrawal: unsupported generalization to arbitrary complete inputs. Remark 6.5.10 restricts ordinary/completed pullback agreement to compositions of qcqs weakly etale maps and constructible closed immersions; Stacks 099N(5) concerns completed pullback. The retained finite-Tor parent is instead proved from explicit projective charts, bounded-projective completeness, and affine-tree descent.

from.place: Fixed finite-field datum reduction of ordinary pullback completeness
